What is a bottleneck in a network?
A point where capacity is lower than the surrounding traffic demand, limiting throughput
Throughput limited at one point despite higher capacity elsewhere
A 1 Gbps server connects through a 100 Mbps uplink to the core. Where is the bottleneck?
Which practice helps locate a bottleneck?
Measuring throughput and utilization at each hop
A fast LAN feeds a slow internet circuit, limiting downloads. Where is the bottleneck?
Which fix addresses a bottlenecked uplink?
Upgrading the uplink or aggregating links
A server's disk is slow, limiting network application performance. Is this a network bottleneck?
No, it is a server/storage bottleneck, not the network
Which tool helps identify a throughput bottleneck between two points?
A device negotiates 100 Mbps instead of 1 Gbps, bottlenecking traffic. What should be checked?
The cable quality and speed/duplex settings
Which practice helps prevent bottlenecks when adding high-bandwidth servers?
Ensuring uplinks and paths can handle the aggregate load
A firewall with limited throughput slows all internet traffic. What is the bottleneck?
Which fix addresses a firewall throughput bottleneck?
Upgrading to a firewall with higher throughput capacity
A single old switch between two fast segments limits speed. What is the fix?
Replacing the switch with one that supports the required speed
Which symptom helps distinguish a bottleneck from general congestion?
Throughput caps at a specific point regardless of overall load elsewhere
A wireless client is limited by an older standard while the AP is faster. Where is the bottleneck?
Which practice helps resolve an endpoint bottleneck?
Upgrading the endpoint's NIC or wireless adapter
A VPN concentrator caps throughput for remote users. What is the bottleneck?
Which fix addresses a VPN throughput bottleneck?
Scaling the VPN device or offloading encryption
A storage network bottleneck slows backups. What should be checked?
The storage link speed, MTU, and array performance
Which practice helps confirm a bottleneck's location?
Testing throughput in segments to isolate the slow link
A link aggregation should relieve a bottleneck but one flow still caps at one link's speed. Why?
A single flow uses one member link due to hashing
Which design reduces bottlenecks in a data center fabric?
A spine-leaf design with adequate bandwidth
A bottleneck appears at the internet edge during peak streaming. What is the direct fix?
Increasing internet bandwidth or applying QoS to streaming
Which symptom suggests a CPU bottleneck on a router?
High CPU utilization with increasing latency and drops
Which fix addresses a router CPU bottleneck?
Upgrading the router or offloading features to hardware
A bottleneck is suspected between a client and server. Which tool measures the actual throughput?
iperf or a similar throughput tool
Which practice helps avoid a bottleneck when consolidating servers?
Ensuring the shared uplink can handle the combined traffic
A bottleneck is caused by a half-duplex link in the path. What is the fix?
Correcting the link to full duplex
Which symptom indicates a NIC bottleneck on a busy server?
The NIC is saturated while the network path has spare capacity
Which fix addresses a server NIC bottleneck?
Adding or upgrading NICs, possibly with teaming
A bottleneck appears only for traffic crossing a specific slow WAN link. What is the fix?
Upgrading that WAN link or optimizing the traffic over it
Which practice helps document a bottleneck resolution?
Recording the location, cause, and measured throughput improvement
A legacy 10/100 switch bottlenecks gigabit devices. What is the fix?
Replacing it with a gigabit switch
Which symptom suggests a bottleneck at a shared resource like a NAS?
Many clients slow down when accessing the same resource
Which practice helps identify whether the bottleneck is network or application?
Comparing network throughput to application performance
A bottleneck is caused by an MTU mismatch fragmenting traffic. What is the fix?
Aligning MTU across the path to avoid fragmentation
Which design choice reduces a single-link bottleneck between buildings?
Aggregating links or using higher-capacity fiber
A bottleneck appears at a proxy inspecting all web traffic. What is the fix?
Scaling the proxy or distributing the load
Which symptom helps confirm a path bottleneck?
Throughput is limited to the capacity of the slowest link in the path
Which practice helps prevent bottlenecks in virtualized hosts?
Ensuring host uplinks and virtual switches have adequate bandwidth
A bottleneck is traced to an overloaded wireless controller. What is the fix?
Scaling the controller or distributing APs across controllers
Which tool helps compare expected versus actual throughput on a link?
A speed/throughput test against the known link capacity
A bottleneck appears because a critical path uses a single 1 Gbps link for aggregated traffic. What is the fix?
Upgrading to 10 Gbps or aggregating multiple links
Which practice helps confirm a bottleneck fix improved performance?
A bottleneck is caused by an old cable limiting a port to 100 Mbps. What is the fix?
Replacing the cable with one rated for gigabit
Which symptom indicates the bottleneck is at the internet edge, not the LAN?
LAN transfers are fast but internet transfers are slow
Which practice helps avoid bottlenecks during peak events?
Provisioning capacity for expected peak loads
A bottleneck is found at a Layer 3 device doing software routing. What is the fix?
Using hardware-based (ASIC) forwarding or a faster device
Which practice helps distinguish a bottleneck from packet loss causes?
Testing throughput and checking for errors versus pure capacity limits
A bottleneck limits a backup window, risking incomplete backups. What is the fix?
Increasing the path bandwidth or scheduling/optimizing backups
